# <!--name-->Claude Review<!--/name-->

<!--description-->
Reviews a pull request's Terraform plans (Atlantis, Spacelift), Helm diff and code with Claude and returns the review as an output. Claude has no GitHub write access here; pair with claude-review/post to publish the result.
<!--/description-->

Most repositories should call the reusable workflow instead:
see [`.github/workflows/docs/claude-review.md`](../.github/workflows/docs/claude-review.md).
Use this action directly when you need your own trigger, gate or concurrency rules.

## Requirements

- Check out the pull request head into the workspace before this step.
- Run it in a job whose token is read-only (`contents: read`, `pull-requests: read`, plus
  `checks: read` and `statuses: read` for CI context, and `id-token: write` for workload identity
  federation).
- Authenticate with workload identity federation where possible: pass the repository's
  `anthropic_federation_rule_id` and `anthropic_service_account_id` from the `workloads` output of
  global-platform-admin `anthropic/tf/console` and leave `anthropic_api_key` empty.
- Pass the `review` output to [`claude-review/post`](./post/README.md) in a separate job with
  `pull-requests: write`.

## What Claude sees

The action fetches, with fixed queries, the PR metadata and changed files, non-minimized
Atlantis and Spacelift comments, the Helm diff (artifact or comment), kubeconform failures,
checks and human discussion into `$RUNNER_TEMP/claude-review/`. The set follows the trigger:
plan triggers get no Helm diff, `helm-diff` gets no plan comments, `on-demand` and
`pull-request` get everything, so two reviews on one PR do not repeat each other. Checks from
this run and other Claude review jobs are dropped. HTML comments are stripped from
fetched bodies. The prompt in [`prompt.md`](./prompt.md) treats all of it as untrusted data.
Repo-level `.claude/`, `.mcp.json`, `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` are removed from the checkout and
memory files are not loaded before Claude runs. Claude returns structured output matching [`schema.json`](./schema.json); the comment is rendered from
that, not from free text, with `@mentions` neutralized and images turned into plain links so an
injected review cannot notify people or trigger remote fetches.

## Example Usage

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@<sha>
  with:
    ref: refs/pull/${{ github.event.issue.number }}/head
    persist-credentials: false
- id: review
  uses: mozilla/deploy-actions/claude-review@<sha>
  with:
    anthropic_federation_rule_id: fdrl_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx # or anthropic_api_key
    anthropic_service_account_id: svac_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
    pr_number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
    trigger: on-demand
    atlantis_bot: ${{ vars.ATLANTIS_GITHUB_USER }}
```
